title: Predicting satisfaction of counterfactual explanations from human ratings of explanatory qualities
core_idea: Analyze a dataset of counterfactual explanations rated by 206 human participants across seven explanatory criteria (feasibility, coherence, complexity, understandability, completeness, fairness, trust) and model overall satisfaction as a function of these criteria, while examining demographic effects, to inform the design of counterfactual explanation methods.
tldr: Model how multiple human-rated explanatory qualities (beyond a single satisfaction score) relate to overall satisfaction with counterfactual explanations to guide user- and context-aware explanation design.
